intent: Provide a typed 12-phase carrier group (12th-root-like finite phase object) for the typed AX20/T162 direction, without asserting any canonical embedding choice, and without implying theta export or QW-2191 discharge.

notes.noncanonicity_warning: Any group isomorphism Z_12_v1 -> Phase_12_v1 depends on a choice of generator/orientation; the isomorphism family has 4 elements corresponding to units u in (Z/12Z)^× = {1,5,7,11}.

hard_limits: Does not select a canonical embedding of Z_12_v1 into Phase_12_v1.
Does not define a connection/holonomy (Berry phase) construction.
Does not force a 1/2 density split from sigma_int.
Does not export theta_1/theta_2 and does not claim O(2)-cut closure nor QW-2191 discharge.
